Title: [ORIGINS] VTES Events Schedule, the US Nats, and Important Updates

Messages.Author: Kevin M.
Messages.Body:
Given the opening of GenCon registration, I'd like to post the VTES schedule 
for the Origins09 convention http://www.originsgamefair.com/ as well as a 
few pieces of Origins news.

1. Beginning this year, the United States VTES National Championships will 
be held at Origins.  This year, the U.S. Championship Event will consist of 
a simple 3R+F Constructed event, but I am very interested in alternate 
formats and will likely run something else in the future.  Please speak with 
me regarding your ideas when you see me or email me via the address given at 
the top of the Las Vegas WebPages in my sig.

2. White Wolf will not have a booth in the Exhibitor Hall this year.  Oscar, 
will still be at Origins and will continue to bring VTES (and whatever 
other) product to sell to players at a reduced rate.  Please contact Oscar 
before Origins and let him know what you want to buy.

ORIGINS 2009 VTES SCHEDULE
============================
Jay Kristoff's Pre-Origins:Constructed #0, 2R+F
WEDNESDAY, June 24th, ~6:00 PM
(more info to come on this event, e.g. time and place)

Constructed #1, 2R+F
THURSDAY, June 25th, 11:00 AM

Constructed #2, 2R+F
THURSDAY, June 25th, 5:00 PM

U.S. National Championship, 3R+F
FRIDAY, June 26th, 1:00 PM

North American Qualifier, 3R+F
SATURDAY, June 27th, 10:00 AM

Recursion Draft, 7 packs, 2R+F
(likely to be all KoT; possibly the next set, if it is legal in time)
SATURDAY, June 27th, 6:00 PM

Constructed #3, 2R+F
SUNDAY, June 28th, 11:00 AM
